definitions.explanation: Any condition affecting the heart, including coronary artery disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心臓病|しんぞうびょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}している→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather is hospitalized due to heart disease.
